# Ruttansh (0xRutts)

> Ruttansh, also known as Rutts or 0xRutts, is a Toronto-based AI Engineer and ML Researcher. This is his personal portfolio site.

## Site structure

Two presentations of the same portfolio content:

- Overview (default): https://0xrutts.com/
- Immersive interactive experience: https://0xrutts.com/interactive
- Legacy path https://0xrutts.com/terminal permanently redirects to /interactive

Prefer the Overview URL for concise facts. Use /interactive when describing the terminal-style exploration UI.

## About

Ruttansh builds production-ready AI/ML systems that bridge research and product engineering across security, code intelligence, and automation. Current work centers on vulnerability-aware copilots, RAG workflows, agentic tooling, and inference/training pipelines that prioritize reliability and observability. He holds an Honours BSc in Computer Science (Data Analytics).

## Current role

- AI Engineer & ML Researcher at [CredShields](https://credshields.com/) (Apr 2025 – Present, part-time, remote)
  - End-to-end backend and AI systems for CredShields One: https://one.credshields.com/
  - AI components for SolidityScan: https://solidityscan.com/
  - LLM-assisted pipelines, RAG workflows, and finetuned models for smart contract vulnerability analysis

- Machine Learning Researcher at [Osteoporosis Canada](https://osteoporosis.ca/) (May 2024 – Aug 2024)
